name: Outreach
overview: Scripture reveals outreach as a divine calling to proclaim the good news of salvation and the reign of God, as seen in Isaiah 52:7 and Matthew 10:7. Believers are commissioned to go forth boldly, speaking the words God commands and making disciples of all nations through teaching and baptism, as instructed in Jeremiah 1:7 and Matthew 28:19. This mission also encompasses acts of mercy and hospitality, caring for the hungry, thirsty, and strangers, reflecting Christ’s heart for the lost, exemplified in Matthew 25:35. Ultimately, outreach is grounded in God’s purpose to bring peace and hope to others, consistent with the assurance of His plans for a hopeful future in Jeremiah 29:11.
